## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Saint Augustine, United States. It starts at 83 King Street.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This impressive concrete and crushed coquina construction transformed the buildings in the city of St. Augustine after its completion. It still has the power to wow you before you've even stepped inside!
>
> Witness a Gilded Age masterpiece built in 1883 and feel the history seeping through its wonderful walls. Study the architecture inspired by the Alhambra Palace in Granada, Spain. Explore the original art and antique collection inside, wander amongst the furnishings, and get up close to colorful pottery, impressive paintings, and sculptures from around the world.
>
> Feel free to take your time, and don't miss the chance to get more info directly into your ears via an audio guide. You'll learn the history of the building - it used to be a club - its importance in St. Augustine, as well as fun facts about the art collection inside.
